meta.name: Timber Creek Purge
meta.details: Timber Creek to Donkey Creek - Rozet
meta.notes:
Imported from TIMBER CREEK TO DONKEY CREEK.kmz as a elevation profile.
Elevation: USGS 3DEP (National Map Elevation Point Query Service), 332 points at 250 ft spacing with peak refinement, fetched 2026-10-21.
West to east purge to tankage on the east end (Donkey Creek).
6" NPS. Old, vertical well, campbell county crude. Specs unknown other than "sour crude". WT is .156".

Bundled 2026-10-22 as the friction-transition test case. 80 cSt is an assumed value for Minnelusa crude (no assay yet; bracket roughly 40-300 cSt). At 80 cSt the pig runs at Re about 1,300-4,500 across 1.5-5 mph, right across the laminar-turbulent transition. Before the Churchill friction factor the pig sat at exactly 2.567 mph (the Re 2300 speed) from MP 4.8 to 11.1. Viscosity (80 cSt) and N2 budget (133,000 SCF, the run that showed the plateau) are set through job setup.

--- Job setup ---
Pig MP 0 -> 13.917; exit 50 psig modulating up to MOP at the stop. Powder River Basin / Wyoming Sweet crude (API ~40), SG 0.82, 80 cSt. Pipe 6.625" x 0.156" (MP 0-13.917).
MOP 700.0 psig; max drive 700.0 psig; N2 spread 700.0 psig / 20,000 SCFM. Speed 1.5/3/5 mph (min/target/max). Pack and coast: 133,000 SCF at 74% of MOP.
Job type: speed-capped, friction-dominated, transitional, gravity-assisted.
ASSUMED - CONFIRM: Specific gravity: 0.82; N2 spread maximum rate: 20000 SCFM; Target pig speed: 3 mph; Pressure held at the endpoint: 50 psig; Pack pressure: 519 psig (highest flat pack with every joint at or under MOP, column at rest).
--- end job setup ---
